ranked.headline: Single-cell methods resolve subclonal and cell-type regulatory heterogeneity in disease
ranked.summary: Single-cell datasets now expose subclonal MSI divergence, cell type-specific RNA editing, and age-linked AML regulatory networks across patient cohorts.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked and automated tools for microbial genome assembly, typing, and profiling
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks microbial genome tools on simulated and gold-standard data and corrects sequencing-error artifacts in amplicon phylogenetics.

ranked.headline: Single-cell multiomics resolves senescent cell states across tissues and cell types
ranked.summary: Cross-layer single-cell profiling now pairs metabolite, protein, and transcript measurements with computational refinement of sparse senescence markers.

ranked.headline: Deep models map DNA, epigenetic, and transcriptomic inputs onto regulatory outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend deep sequence and single-cell models to perturbation response, with DNA context entering at the perturbation locus.

ranked.headline: Learned latent spaces reconcile incomplete and heterogeneous multimodal biological data
ranked.summary: Deep models now impute missing modalities, align pathology with transcriptomics, and super-resolve spatial data across recent preprints and publications.

ranked.headline: Graph and generative models impute and integrate incomplete spatial omics data
ranked.summary: Incomplete and cross-platform spatial omics data motivate new imputation, integration, and scalable embedding methods.

ranked.headline: Statistical and learned models infer regulatory relationships from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent single-cell and chromatin-resolved studies extend regulatory inference to CRE activity, lineage reconstruction, and promoter-selective perturbations.

ranked.headline: Deep models advance protein-ligand affinity and biomolecular interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend learned binding affinity prediction, coarse pocket representations, and interaction-aware antibody and TCR modelling.

ranked.headline: Computational methods resolve regulatory structure within single-cell and tissue samples
ranked.summary: Single-cell multiomic and epigenomic atlases now support inference of regulatory programs and trans effects at cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Learned models extend protein energetics, stability, and ensemble prediction
ranked.summary: Protein language models and AlphaFold-based ensembles now target energetics, stability, and disorder beyond static structure prediction.

ranked.headline: LLM agents and benchmarks extend to molecule optimization and rare disease diagnosis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published agent paper test LLMs and agentic systems on drug-specific tasks beyond standalone text generation.

ranked.headline: Protein and genomic language models reused via tokenization, pooling, and probing
ranked.summary: Recent work tests how protein and DNA model representations transfer to design, variant prediction, and structural probing.

ranked.headline: Robust high-dimensional feature selection and cross-modal fusion in biomedical prediction
ranked.summary: Recent papers couple correlation-robust feature selection with cross-modal fusion and synthetic data augmentation for biomedical prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: New computational tools address PTM mapping, crosslink rescoring, and DIA workflows
ranked.summary: Richer mass-spec datasets across PTMs, cross-links, and DIA quantitation demand analysis tools that model biological and statistical structure explicitly.

ranked.headline: Inferring causal and dynamical models of single-cell and neural system behavior
ranked.summary: Recent work tests inferred causal and dynamical models against ground truth or predictive validity across neural and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Plastome inversions and residual recombination reshape genome structure across lineages
ranked.summary: Reanalysis of existing shallow-WGS data now reveals plastome inversions, and residual recombination exposes deleterious mutations in clonal hybrid lineages.

ranked.headline: Computational inference from tandem MS spectra links unknown metabolites to structures
ranked.summary: Billion-scale public MS/MS repositories now support reverse search, generative elucidation, and cross-polarity similarity computed directly on spectra.

ranked.headline: Computational tools infer allele, centromere, and chromatin features from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Long-read and pangenome assemblies now support de novo annotation of alleles, transcripts, centromeres, and regulatory regions from sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Learned priors steer protein diffusion, docking, and receptor-binding simulations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test inference-time biasing, alignment, and language-model scoring as levers for protein design and binding prediction.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models explain gene circuit oscillations and ATP-coupled threshold dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study extend mechanistic dynamical models to transcription yield, PBPK scaling, and metabolic homeostasis.

ranked.headline: Open tools unify simulation, trajectory analysis, and Bayesian modeling in biology
ranked.summary: Recent releases package simulation, trajectory analysis, and compositional modeling as installable software with scripted or graphical access for reproducible…

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and open models for sequence-based biomolecular prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Matched-condition comparisons and openly released models are now central to evaluating ML predictors for peptides, structures, and splicing.

ranked.headline: Harmonized metadata layers make public omics samples and studies queryable and reusable
ranked.summary: Public omics reuse depends on consistent annotations, and new preprints deliver harmonized resources with query tools and portable packaging.

ranked.headline: Mobile element-aware methods track transposon dynamics across fungal, fly, and grass…
ranked.summary: Reference-free pangenome and mobile element-aware distance methods now separate transposable element signal from genome comparison artifacts.

ranked.headline: Single-cell repeat mosaicism and regulatory variant mapping across human genomes
ranked.summary: Single-cell and population-scale methods now resolve somatic repeat mutations alongside methylation and chromatin regulation.

ranked.headline: Cross-taxa comparisons reveal conserved RNA, polymerase, and phage features
ranked.summary: Expanding genome and metagenome collections now allow conserved regulatory, replicative, and phage features to be mapped across taxa and hosts.

ranked.headline: ML models guide design of RNA aptamers, RNA sensors and long DNA synthesis
ranked.summary: Learned sequence models now drive nucleic acid design, including single-round aptamer evolution reported in February 2026.

ranked.headline: Web tools pair LLM interfaces with omics matrix analysis and enrichment interpretation
ranked.summary: LLM-driven web platforms now wrap omics visualization, enrichment interpretation, and gene regulatory curation in inspectable interfaces.

ranked.headline: Multiscale graph pangenome resolves homo(eo)logs in mixed-ploidy sugarcane
ranked.summary: A multiscale graph pangenome of nine Saccharum assemblies enables dosage-aware analysis across 417 sugarcane accessions.

ranked.headline: Resting-state fMRI and connectomes as behavioral and clinical brain biomarkers
ranked.summary: Temporal, causal, and noise-robust modeling of resting-state fMRI is advancing its use for linking brain activity to clinical and behavioral measures.

ranked.headline: Learned molecular representations drive generative design and activity prediction
ranked.summary: Transformer and diffusion models now reuse learned molecular and interface embeddings for macrocycle design, ADC activity prediction, and QUBO-based search.

ranked.headline: Integrated RdRp HMM and pipeline tools advance RNA virus discovery and annotation
ranked.summary: Established viral reference resources for RdRp profiles, ICTV taxonomy, and Pfam domains are now being consolidated into reusable single-pipeline workflows.

ranked.headline: Graph-based methods scale genotyping, ancestry representation, and phenotype simulation
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale cohorts and low-coverage sequencing make graph representations that scale and remain stable on sparse inputs a practical requirement.

ranked.headline: Geometry-aware descriptors are being used to curate particles in cryo-EM and cryo-ET
ranked.summary: TANGO's point-cloud and twist-vector features enable rotation-invariant particle curation in cryo-electron tomography.

ranked.headline: Simulations reveal flux, electrofusion, and redox carrier steering mechanisms
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling and residue-level simulations now resolve transient states governing membrane fusion, condensate flux, and electron transfer.

ranked.headline: Computational tools and datasets for cryo-EM RNA motif modeling and particle…
ranked.summary: A 125,000-map cryo-EM RNA motif benchmark and new 2D classification and particle filtering methods target ML-based structure modeling.

ranked.headline: Stochastic and deterministic models of infection spread across host and population scales
ranked.summary: Recent preprints model stress-altered susceptibility, temperature-dependent Wolbachia infection loss, and superspreading tails in epidemic waves.

ranked.headline: Inference for allele genotyping, multiplex primer design and single-cell demultiplexing
ranked.summary: Scalable, variant-aware inference methods now target haplotype-resolved typing, multiplex primer design and pooled single-cell genotype assignment.

ranked.headline: Stochastic models couple individual interactions to population evolutionary outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent February 2026 preprints apply stochastic and game-theoretic models to how individual-level noise and interactions shape population-scale evolution.

ranked.headline: Cloud platforms automate docking, dynamic MD, and visualization of AI-designed molecules
ranked.summary: Three 2026 publications describe cloud-ready tools that package docking, MD, and curation of AI-designed molecules into accessible workflows.
